title: I used AI to generate some wild variations of the classic Blender donut - all of these were generated with just a text prompt
author: PolyhiveHQ

comments.author: PolyhiveHQ
comments.body:
I’ve been following the progress of text-to-image models over the past several months, and thought that it would be really cool to see if I could use the same methods to create textures for 3D meshes. I made [this tool](https://polyhive.ai/ai?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=organic_post&utm_campaign=march_donut_post&utm_id=aigamedev) to automate the process.

Best results are created by providing detailed prompts (both positive and negative) and by varying the seed and guidance scale.
